notes: Domestic burning is a leading PM2.5 source; which measures extend to Wales will shape progress against the PM2.5 target being set under the 2024 Act (see pm25-air-quality-target-regulations-wales-2026).
summary: From 22 January to 19 March 2026 the Welsh Government carried a consultation, held on the Defra site, on UK Government proposals to reduce fine particulate matter (PM2.5) and smoke from solid fuel burning, including a new emission limit for stoves, mandatory appliance labelling and mandatory health labelling of fuels. The page said some options would be taken forward UK-wide and some might apply in England only, and that responses were being reviewed.
title: UK-wide consultation on stove emission limits and fuel labelling to cut PM2.5 closed; outcome awaited
